verdict.rationale: Puzzle is documented only as a hosted, browser-based accounting service with an API, an MCP integration, and data export. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-premises, or open-source deployment of the core product. Self-hosting is a fair question for an accounting platform, so the axis applies, and without evidence the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
